purpose: Public source-of-truth corpus for Notary Geek route-first notary, apostille, identity, platform, and source-quality research.

publicOnlyPolicy.summary: This corpus is for public law, public guidance, public answer-engine examples, public source archive notes, and public Notary Geek routing materials only.

sourceSets.name: Official Hague and U.S. apostille sources
sourceSets.use: Primary official references for Hague Apostille Convention status and U.S. apostille preparation requirements

sourceSets.name: Notary Geek operational public pages
sourceSets.use: Public operational service pages that may be cited only after they are fetched in the current run

sourceSets.name: Public discovery and archive
sourceSets.use: Reusable public evidence and answer-engine correction examples

sourceSets.name: Public GitHub topic briefs
sourceSets.use: Machine-readable public topic briefs maintained in this repository

sourceSets.name: Public answer-engine correction briefs
sourceSets.use: Machine-readable public correction briefs for observed answer-engine behavior

sourceSets.name: Law source feeds
sourceSets.use: Published law-source cache and official-source index

strictExclusions: Customer names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, or WhatsApp message contents
Persona inquiry data, selfies, IDs, status details, or webhook payloads
Payment data, Stripe payloads, Jotform payloads, private SQL rows, and internal secrets
Private correspondence unless it has already been intentionally converted into a public-safe source archive note
